To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
GPU-based swarm intelligence algorithms can be used to improve the accuracy and efficiency with which data mining problems are solved.

(a) GPU computing is a viable platform for implementing swarm intelligence algorithms for solving data mining problems and (b) the GPU implementations of AntMiner and ClusterFlock algorithms are competitive with other swarm and traditional methods for solving classification and clustering problems, respectively.
GPU-based swarm intelligence algorithms can be competitive with other methods in terms of both accuracy and speed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of the GPU parallel computing model to two types of swarm intelligent algorithms for data mining: AntMinerGPU for rule-based classification and ClusterFlockGPU for data clustering.
developing and testing GPU-based implementations of swarm intelligence data mining techniques.
developing a framework for GPU-accelerated swarm intelligence algorithms and demonstrates that GPU-based swarm intelligence algorithms are a practical solution for data mining problems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
GPU-based swarm intelligence is a promising and efficient approach for solving data mining problems, and that the algorithms we present in this paper are a step in that direction.
GPU-acceleration is a viable option for data mining algorithms based on swarm intelligence.
GPU-based implementations of swarm intelligence algorithms can be competitive with traditional data mining methods and are able to produce results that are comparable in both speed and quality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GPU computing provides a significant speed-up for swarm intelligence algorithms, which is particularly beneficial when dealing with large data sets.
the GPU-based swarm intelligence methods we have developed can be used to solve a wide range of data mining problems in a highly efficient manner.
the GPU-based implementations for the AntMiner and ClusterFlock algorithms are able to achieve a speedup of 5x-20x and 3x-4x, respectively.
The main takeaway from our work is that
GPU-accelerated swarm intelligence systems can be used to solve data mining problems in a computationally efficient manner.
swarm intelligence is an excellent candidate for acceleration with the GPU, and can be applied to a wide range of data mining problems.
GPU computing is an attractive option for swarm intelligence algorithms due to the high degree of parallelism inherent to swarm intelligence algorithms.
